original_card.first_experiment: Choose one assumption ID (native_all_columns, owned_erasure, compiler, precision_tape, analytic_recovery), one quantified implication and exact dependency closure. Check current handoffs, including #5625 row reentry and #5707 root-prefix lowering, without treating their partial scope as the whole theorem. Prove or falsify that implication with a caller-bound argument; stop at the chosen obligation. Finite tests or root digits do not discharge an all-size statement.
original_card.bottleneck_link: Judge the actual current supplier contract and complete signed target/paid bill; frozen-profile ceilings require an applicability proof.
allowed_variations: One exact source head, helper/cut region or quantified proposition and changed hypothesis; check live handoffs first. Different seeds are not different scopes.

Treating an archived proposal or local numerical pass as complete supplier admission.

actual_scope: Prove exact permutation/monomial symmetry limits for two-sided gauged heterogeneous Gaussian tensors, transfer absolute rounding and inverse errors, and identify actual fine-prime physical square-block bounds and the defined dense-format obstruction.
scope_change_reason: The published C6 normalized-kernel theorem explicitly excludes gauges and physical/inverse error transfer. This source-bound successor closes those specific interfaces without extending to a global caller.
bottleneck_link: Analytic-recovery interface: rule out long symmetry-cycle certificates even after gauges on the actual retained square factors, while leaving implicit and non-cycle applications open.
stop_rule: Stop after the stated source/proof/error and bounded exact checks plus independent review. Exclude full periodic matrices, rectangular blocks, arbitrary rank/runtime bounds and new kappa.
evidence: PROOF.md proves the exact invariant/monomial centralizer, source physical diagonal bounds, forward/inverse margins and dense-format minimum. Registered primary commands cover 81464 vertex permutations per forward/inverse target, 922 exact source exponent pairs, rational error cases and 11 failure controls. Normal/optimized receipts agree. Independent review is separately recorded.
author: Prepared for Jerry Chen / @CubeJerry
ai_assistance: Substantial OpenAI assistance. The lead proposed the invariant/error objective; the worker independently derived exact centralizer and physical source bounds, the inverse transfer, cost limits and exact tests. Separate AI-agent review is not human or formal-kernel certification.
